senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. פטט, s. v. פַּטָּטָא) [to divide; cmp. גזר,] to decree, decide, judge.
units: <cite ref="Ruth Rabbah, Petichta 1">Ruth R. to I, 1</cite> <he>אוי לדור שׁשָׁפְטוּ … צריכין להִשָּׁפט</he> woe to the generation that judge (criticise) their judges, and woe to the generation whose judges need to be judged; <cite ref="Bava Batra 15b:10">B. Bath. 15ᵇ</cite> (ref. to Ruth l. c.) <he>דור שׁשׁוֹפֵט וכ׳</he> it was a generation that judged its judges &c., v. <cite ref="S01071"><he>קִיסָּם</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Sotah 10a:3">Sot. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>זכור לי … שׁשָׁפַטְתִּי וכ׳</he> remember unto me the twenty (-two) years that I judged Israel, and never did I say to them, carry a stick for me from one place to another; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="U00495"><he>שׁוֹפֵט</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be judged, criticised. Ruth R. l. c., v. supra.
